message: What should I visit in Rome? I have two days.
response:
Here are some notable attractions you can visit in Rome over two days:

1. **Temple of Minerva Medica (nymphaeum)**: A ruined nymphaeum from the late 3rd or early 4th century CE. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Temple_of_Minerva_Medica_(nymphaeum))

2. **Aqua Appia**: The first Roman aqueduct, constructed in 312 BC. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aqua_Appia)

3. **Acqua Pia Antica Marcia**: An aqueduct restored by Pope Pius IX. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Acqua_Pia_Antica_Marcia)

4. **Porta Maggiore Basilica**: An underground basilica from the 1st century BC. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porta_Maggiore_Basilica)

5. **Porta Maggiore**: An ancient gate in the Aurelian Walls. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Porta_Maggiore)

6. **Aqua Anio Novus**: An ancient Roman aqueduct completed by Emperor Claudius. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aqua_Anio_Novus)

7. **Tomb of Eurysaces the Baker**: A well-preserved funerary monument. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tomb_of_Eurysaces_the_Baker)

8. **Manzoni – Museo della Liberazione**: An underground station with historical significance. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manzoni_%E2%80%93_Museo_della_Liberazione_(Rome_Metro))

9. **Museo nazionale degli strumenti musicali**: A museum of musical instruments. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Museo_nazionale_degli_strumenti_musicali)

10. **Santa Bibiana**: A Baroque style church designed by Gian Lorenzo Bernini. [More info](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Santa_Bibiana)

I recommend starting with the **Temple of Minerva Medica** and **Porta Maggiore** for their historical significance and proximity to each other.
